::: {#exr-minibatch-epochs}

#### Ten passes over the data

Train a fresh [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) from `make_mlp()` for 10 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch) of full-batch gradient descent with [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.5.
Train another for 10 epochs of [minibatch gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-minibatch) with batch size 32 and learning rate 0.1,
taking each [epoch](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch)'s minibatches from a fresh shuffle of the training images
rather than drawing them with replacement.
Which has the lower training loss after 10 epochs?

:::
